_comment: A 46-man Infantry block on 10 files (a short rear rank of 6) stands alone in drill mode at (520, 440) facing south. At tick 24 it about-faces in place (V), which leaves its grid folded a half-turn under the men. At tick 180 it is narrowed to 9 files ([) and ordered north (right-click at (520, 240)) on the same tick, so the order's hold-ground re-square meets a file count no slot query has laid out yet and deals the files from where the men stand. The tick-180 sample is the deal before anyone has walked: every man's slot lies within two rank pitches (36 wu, rank pitch 18) of him, since the full files' men keep their ground and the rest step up at most a rank and across at most a file. On main the re-square reversed each file's ranks on top of that deal, sending the farthest man 81.5 wu, through the block to the other end of his file.
